blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Self-attention's quadratic complexity constitutes a core bottleneck for Vision Transformers (ViTs). Existing efficiency-oriented optimizations, including softmax-based and linear attention (LA) variants, generally compromise model representational capacity, leading to inevitable performance degradation. We propose a novel linear attention which alleviates this efficiency-capability dilemma. For the first time, we embed an Adaptive Channel Compression and Activation Purification (ACCAP) mechanism into the QKV projection of linear attention, which enables the model to retain high-dimensional feature information while performing computations with reduced channels. We further fuse a focused kernel function and a self-gating module into ACCAP to construct a lightweight linear attention module (ACCAP-LA). Our theoretical analysis shows that, compared to standard linear attention, ACCAP-LA reduces the attention module's parameter count by 79.17% and FLOPs by 77.5%. Extensive experiments demonstrate ACCAP-LA's effectiveness: when applied to ViT, it achieves 79.4% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K with only 5.8M parameters, and more notably, it boasts strong cross-architecture compatibility, boosting EfficientViT-b1 and PVT-T by 3.3% and 3.4% respectively.
blocks.zh: 自觉的四维复杂性构成了视觉变形器(ViTs)的核心瓶颈. 现有的以效率为导向的优化,包括基于软马克斯和线性关注(LA)的变体,一般会损害模型代表能力,导致不可避免的性能退化. 我们提出一种新的线性关注,减轻这种效率-能力难题。 我们第一次将一个适应性通道压缩和活性纯化(ACCAP)机制嵌入到线性注意力的QKV投影中,这使得模型在进行减少通道的计算的同时能够保留高维特征信息. 我们进一步将一个有重点的内核功能和一个自标模块纳入ACCAP,以构建一个轻量级线性关注模块(ACCAP-LA)。 我们的理论分析表明,与标准线性关注相比,ACCAP-LA将关注模块的参数数减少了79.17%,FLOPs减少了77.5%。 广泛的实验证明了ACCAP-LA的有效性:当应用到VIT时,它在ImageNet-1K上达到了79.4%的Top-1精度,只有5.8M参数,更值得注意的是,它夸耀出强大的跨结构相容性,将高效ViT-b1和PVT-T分别提升了3.3%和3.4%.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) [ 1 ] have become the dominant paradigm in visual representation learning, delivering state-of-the-art(SOTA) performance on image classification [ 2 ] and object detection [ 3 ] via global self-attention modeling. However, the quadratic complexity ( O ⁡ ( N 2 ) ) (O(N^{2})) of vanilla softmax self-attention [ 4 ] emerges as a core bottleneck hampering their further scaling and deployment.
blocks.zh: Vision Transformers(ViTs)[1]已经成为视觉表现学习,在图像分类上提供最新(SOTA)性能[2]和通过全球自觉模型检测对象[3]的主导范式. 然而,香草软马克思自我注意的四维复杂性(O ⁡(N 2)(O(N^{2})))[4]作为一个核心瓶颈出现,阻碍它们进一步缩放和部署.

blocks.en: To address this issue, numerous efficiency-oriented optimizations have emerged, falling into two main categories: softmax-based approaches and linear attention-based ones. Yet all variants under these two categories compromise model capability in different aspects, leading to performance degradation.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,出现了许多面向效率的优化,分为两大类:基于软马克思的方法和基于线性关注的方法。 然而,这两个类别下的所有变体都在不同方面损害模型能力,导致性能退化。

blocks.en: Optimizations for softmax attention can be split into two distinct strategies: token grouping typified by Swin Transformer [ 5 ] , and resolution compression represented by PVT v2 [ 6 ] . However, as shown in Figure 1 (a) and (c), token grouping impairs the model’s capacity of global information perception, while resolution compression sacrifices its fine-grained feature sensitivity.
blocks.zh: 软马克思注意力的优化可分为两种不同的策略: Swin Transformer [5] 的符号分组和 PVT v2 [6] 所代表的分辨率压缩. 然而,如图1(a)和(c)所示,象征性的分组损害模型的全球信息感知能力,而分辨率压缩则牺牲其精细的特征敏感性。

blocks.en: Linear attention [ 7 ] emerges as a novel attention paradigm that abandons the softmax function. By leveraging the associative law of multiplication, it rearranges the computation order to first compute the Key-Value product ( K T ​ V K^{\mathrm{T}}V ) before multiplying with Query ( Q Q ), thereby reducing the complexity from quadratic to linear. Representative works based on linear attention make targeted optimizations, such as Flatten Transformer [ 8 ] which introduces a kernel function and S3ML [ 9 ] which integrates sampled softmax. However, as illustrated in Figure 1 (b), linear attention can essentially be regarded as a low-rank decomposition and approximation of softmax attention, so even with these improvements, its performance remains unsatisfactory. Furthermore, existing linear attention optimizations mainly focus on the computation stage, leaving channel-wise design in the core QKV projection stage largely underexplored.
blocks.zh: 线性注意[7]作为一个新颖的注意范式出现,放弃软马克思功能. 通过利用乘法的关联定律,它重新安排了计算顺序,先计算出键值产物(K T V K^{\ mathrm{T}}V),然后再与Query(QQ)相乘,从而将复杂性从四进制降至线性. 基于线性关注的代表性作品使目标优化,如Flatten Transformer [8] 引入了内核函数和S3ML [9] 集成样本软马克斯. 然而,如图1(b)所示,线性注意力基本上可以被视为软马克思注意力的低级分解和近似,因此即使有了这些改进,其性能仍然不能令人满意. 此外,现有的线性注意力优化主要侧重于计算阶段,使得核心QKV投影阶段的频道导向设计基本没有得到充分利用.

blocks.en: To address this efficiency-capability dilemma, we propose a novel Adaptive Channel Compression and Activation Purification (ACCAP) mechanism, which we embed into the linear attention QKV projection process for the first time (Figure 1 (d)). Since more channels enable richer multi-dimensional feature representations, ACCAP first allows the model to access such high-dimensional feature representations. It then enables QKV matrices to learn high-dimensional feature semantics via low-dimensional vectors during generation, with actual attention computation performed using fewer channels. Specifically, ACCAP comprises three stages: channel compression, activation purification, and channel expansion, which eliminates computational redundancy in linear attention and effectively preserves and refines critical feature information in the attention module. Intuitively, as illustrated in Figure 2 , the feature rank remains nearly stable through this pipeline, indicating that channel reduction incurs negligible information loss.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这种效率-能力难题,我们提出了一个新的适应性通道压缩和激活净化机制,我们第一次将这一机制嵌入了QKV的线性关注预测过程(图1(d))。 由于更多的渠道可以使更丰富的多维特征表示,ACCAP首先允许模型访问这样的高维特征表示. 然后,它使QKV矩阵在生成过程中通过低维向量学习高维特征语义,实际的注意力计算使用较少的通道进行. 具体而言,ACCAP包含三个阶段:信道压缩,激活净化,信道扩展,消除线性注意力的计算冗余,有效保存和完善了注意力模块中的关键特征信息. 如图2所示,从直觉上看,通过这一管道,特征等级仍然几乎保持稳定,表明通道减少会造成可忽略不计的信息损失。

blocks.en: Notably, the ACCAP mechanism reduces the complexity of standard linear attention from O ⁡ ( N ​ C 2 ) O(NC^{2}) to O ⁡ ( N ​ C 2 / r 2 ) O(NC^{2}/r^{2}) , where r r denotes the compression ratio. Furthermore, we sequentially incorporate a focused kernel function and a self-gating module following ACCAP to construct the ACCAP-augmented Linear Attention (ACCAP-LA). When r = 2 r=2 , theoretical derivations confirm that compared to standard linear attention, ACCAP-LA reduces the parameter count by 79.17% and FLOPs by 77.5%.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,ACCAP机制将标准线性关注的复杂程度从O ⁡(NC 2) O(NC ^{2})降低到O ⁡(NC 2 / r 2) O(NC ^{2}/r^{2}),r表示压缩比. 此外,我们按顺序在ACCAP之后纳入重点内核功能和自定模块,以构建ACCAP强化线性注意(ACCAP-LA)。 当r = 2 r = 2时,理论推论证实与标准线性注意相比,ACCAP-LA将参数数减少79.17%,FLOPs减少77.5%。

blocks.en: Building upon ACCAP-LA, we design a series of ViT models (dubbed ACCAP-ViT-M0 to M3) with varying parameter sizes based on a unified architecture. To validate their effectiveness, we conduct image classification experiments on the ImageNet-1K dataset and object detection experiments on the COCO 2017 dataset. Across models of all scales, ACCAP-ViTs consistently deliver outstanding performance. We summarize our contributions as follows:
blocks.zh: 在ACCAP-LA的基础上,我们设计了一系列VIT模型(dubbbed ACCAP-ViT-M0至M3),基于统一的架构,参数大小不一. 为了验证其有效性,我们在COCO 2017数据集的ImageNet-1K数据集和物体检测实验上进行图像分类实验. 在所有规模的模型中,ACCAP-ViTs始终提供出色的业绩。 我们的贡献总结如下:

blocks.en: • We propose a channel-wise optimization mechanism dubbed ACCAP for linear attention QKV projection, which reduces computational redundancy while alleviating the inherent representational degradation of vanilla linear attention. • We develop a novel lightweight linear attention module ACCAP-LA by integrating ACCAP with a focused kernel function and a self-gating module, achieving a superior efficiency-performance trade-off. • Extensive experiments on ImageNet-1K and COCO 2017 validate that ACCAP-LA achieves competitive performance, high inference efficiency, and strong cross-architecture generalization across various ViT backbones.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们建议采用一个信道优化机制,称为ACCAP,用于线性关注QKV预测,减少计算冗余,同时减轻香草线性关注的内在代表降解. ^ 我们开发了一个新的轻量级线性关注模块ACCAP-LA,将ACCAP与重点内核功能和自我配对模块相结合,实现优异的效率-性能权衡. • 对ImageNet-1K和COCO 2017的广泛实验证实,ACCAP-LA在各种ViT骨干上实现了竞争性能,高推论效率,强跨结构的泛化.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Efficiency Optimization of SoftMax Attention in Vision Transformers
blocks.zh: 2.1 优化视觉变形器中软Max的注意效率

blocks.en: Existing optimizations for softmax attention in ViTs mainly follow two paradigms: token grouping and resolution compression. Token grouping methods, typified by Swin Transformer [ 5 ] , restrict attention within local windows or dynamic clusters to cut computational overhead. Resolution compression approaches, represented by PVT v2 [ 6 ] , reduce token counts via pyramid downsampling. While effective in lowering complexity, both paradigms operate predominantly on the token dimension and inevitably impair global perception or fine-grained feature sensitivity, leaving channel-wise computational redundancy largely unexplored.
blocks.zh: ViTs中现有的软马克思注意力优化主要遵循两个范式:符号分组和分辨率压缩. Token分组法,由Swin Transformer [5] 进行分类,限制本地窗口或动态集群内部的注意力,以减少计算间接费用. 分辨率压缩方法,以PVT v2 [6]为代表,通过金字塔下采样减少符号计数. 这两种模式虽然能够有效地降低复杂性,但主要在象征性层面运作,不可避免地损害全球认知或精细的特征敏感性,使频道计算冗余性基本上得不到探讨。

blocks.en: 2.2 Performance Enhancement for Linear Attention-Based Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 基于线性注意力的模型的性能增强

blocks.en: Linear attention (LA) achieves linear complexity by eliminating softmax and reordering computation, yet its inherent low-rank nature causes severe representational degradation. Existing enhancements mainly revolve around three directions: kernel function design (e.g., Flatten Transformer [ 8 ] with focused kernels to sharpen attention distribution), multi-scale feature integration (e.g., EfficientViT [ 10 ] to enrich semantic contexts), and hybrid architectures that combine LA with softmax or state-space designs. Nevertheless, these strategies yield limited gains or sacrifice inherent linear complexity advantages. Notably, most existing improvements focus on the attention computation stage, while the QKV projection process, which dominates LA’s parameter and computation budget, remains underexplored from a channel-wise perspective.
blocks.zh: 线性注意(LA)通过消除软max和重排计算来实现线性复杂性,然而其固有的低级性质却导致严重的代表退化. 现有的增强主要围绕三个方向进行:内核函数设计(如Flatten Transformer[8],有突出的内核以突出注意力分布),多尺度特性集成(如高效维特[10],以丰富语义背景),以及将LA与软max或状态空间设计相结合的混合结构. 然而,这些战略的收益有限或牺牲了固有的线性复杂性优势。 值得注意的是,现有的大多数改进都集中在注意力计算阶段,而以LA参数和计算预算为主的QKV预测过程,从信道的角度来说,仍然没有得到充分利用。

blocks.en: 2.3 Channel Compression and Gated Activation Mechanisms
blocks.zh: 2.3 信道压缩和受电激活机制

blocks.en: The squeeze-and-excitation (SE) paradigm [ 11 ] pioneers channel-wise adaptive feature reweighting via compression and gating. Follow-ups like CBAM [ 12 ] and ECA-Net [ 13 ] further optimize this paradigm from spatial extension and compression efficiency perspectives. All these methods target feature quality improvement, using channel compression only for attention weight generation rather than cost reduction. SCConv [ 14 ] confirms prevalent channel redundancy in visual models, but also aims at feature refinement instead of cutting attention computation overhead. Gated mechanisms are also widely explored in attention research. Qiu et al. [ 15 ] apply self-gating to boost non-linearity and alleviate attention sinks in LLMs. For visual linear attention, works like HLSM [ 16 ] introduce channel gating in feature fusion stages for diversity enhancement, yet none modify the core QKV projection pipeline.
blocks.zh: 挤压-引力(SE)范式[11]先导的频道-因地制宜的特征通过压缩和调味重新加权. CBAM[12]和ECA-Net[13]等后续行动从空间延伸和压缩效率角度进一步优化了这一范式. 所有这些方法都针对质量的提高,使用信道压缩只是为了产生注意力重量,而不是降低成本. SCConv [14] 确认视觉模型中普遍存在的频道冗余,但也旨在改进特性,而不是削减注意力计算间接费用. 在关注研究中也广泛探索了Gated机制. 邱等编. [15] 采用自我配对法,促进非线性,缓解LLMs的注意力吸收。 对于视觉线性注意,如HLSM[16]在特征聚变阶段引入通道Gating用于多样性增强,然而没有修改核心QKV投影管.

blocks.en: Beyond attention-oriented channel designs, inverted residual bottlenecks [ 17 ] in convolutional networks and low-rank matrix factorization [ 18 ] in attention modules also adopt channel-wise dimension reduction, but both are essentially pure parameter compression strategies without dedicated feature purification mechanisms. More critically, neither of them has been customized to address the inherent representational degradation issue of linear attention from the perspective of QKV projection optimization.
blocks.zh: 除了面向关注的频道设计外,在演化网络中的反向残余瓶颈[17]和在关注模块中的低阶矩阵阶梯化[18]也采用面向通道的维度减小,但两者本质上都是纯参数压缩策略,没有专门的特征净化机制. 更为关键的是,它们都没有被定制,以便从QKV预测优化的角度解决线性关注的内在代表性退化问题。

blocks.en: Despite their widespread use in feature enhancement and computation reduction, channel compression and gating have not been systematically integrated into the QKV projection of linear attention to jointly reduce computational cost and mitigate representational degradation. To this end, we propose the ACCAP mechanism.
blocks.zh: 尽管它们在特征增强和计算减少中被广泛使用,但信道压缩和成色尚未系统地纳入QKV线性关注预测,以联合降低计算成本和减缓代表降解. 为此,我们提议建立ACCAP机制。

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: To address these limitations mentioned above, this paper proposes a novel linear attention mechanism, named ACCAP-LA, from the perspective of feature channel redundancy [ 14 ] . Specifically, we design an Adaptive Channel Compression and Activation Purification (ACCAP) mechanism explicitly tailored for the QKV projection process, and further complement it with a focused kernel function and a self-gating module. This design ensures the model maintains lightweight properties and high efficiency, while significantly boosting its representational capability. Detailed descriptions of the proposed ACCAP-LA mechanism are presented as follows.
blocks.zh: 为解决上述这些局限性,本文从功能频道冗余的角度提出了一个名为ACCAP-LA的新线性关注机制[14]. 具体而言,我们设计了一种适应性通道压缩和激活纯化(ACCAP)机制,明确适合QKV投影过程,并以一个重点突出的内核功能和一个自我配对模块来进一步补充. 这种设计确保了模型保持轻量级特性和高效,同时显著提升其代表能力. 关于拟议的ACCAP-LA机制的详细说明如下。

blocks.en: 3.1 Adaptive Channel Compression and Activation Purification Mechanism
blocks.zh: 3.1 适应性通道压缩和激活净化机制

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Why ACCAP is Necessary?
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 国家 为什么ACCAP是必要的?

blocks.en: Feature channel redundancy is widely verified in existing vision models [ 14 , 19 ] , which motivates the necessity of channel compression in the QKV projection process. The number of channels represents different dimensions of feature representations: a higher channel dimension enables the model to capture multi-faceted semantic information from input features, thereby enhancing the expressiveness of the attention module. However, an excessively large channel dimension introduces substantial computational and memory overhead during the QKV projection and subsequent attention computation, which contradicts the goal of lightweight model design. To reconcile the trade-off between representational capacity and computational efficiency, we propose to leverage high-dimensional channels for rich feature learning, while employing ACCAP for channel compression and activation purification before computation. This design enables the model to encode high-dimensional feature information into a low-dimensional space, achieving competitive performance with significantly reduced computational costs.
blocks.zh: 特性通道冗余在现有的视觉模型[14,19]中得到了广泛的验证,这激发了在QKV投影过程中对通道压缩的必要性. 频道数量代表了特征表达的不同维度: 更高的频道维度使模型能够从输入特征中获取多面语义信息,从而增强关注模块的表达性. 然而,过度大的通道维度在QKV投影和随后的注意力计算过程中引入了大量的计算和内存管理,这与轻量级模型设计的目标相矛盾. 为了调和代表能力和计算效率之间的权衡,我们建议利用高维度渠道进行丰富的特性学习,同时在计算前利用ACCAP进行信道压缩和激活净化. 这种设计使模型能够将高维特性信息编码成一个低维空间,实现竞争性性能,并显著降低计算成本.

blocks.en: 3.1.3 Efficiency Gains from ACCAP
blocks.zh: 3.1.3 ACCAP的效率收益

blocks.en: We quantify the parameter and FLOPs savings of the ACCAP mechanism by comparing the full attention module (encompassing QKV projection and core attention computation) against standard linear attention. In alignment with mainstream ViT efficiency analysis conventions, we ignore bias terms and negligible element-wise operations in all derivations, and count each multiply-add operation as one FLOP for all computational cost statistics throughout this work.

blocks.en: 3.1.4 Distinctions from Inverted Bottlenecks and Low-rank Projections
blocks.zh: 3.1.4 与颠倒的波特伦克和低级预测的区别

blocks.en: To explicitly clarify the novelty boundary of ACCAP against the aforementioned channel compression paradigms, we compare it with the two most relevant structures—inverted residual bottlenecks and low-rank QKV factorization—in terms of design motivation, structural topology, and functional objectives. In contrast to inverted residual bottlenecks, which follow a “narrow-wide-narrow” dimension trajectory that temporarily expands channels for spatial convolution before projecting back to a low-dimensional feature output, ACCAP adopts a “wide-narrow-wide” channel transformation specifically engineered for the QKV projection stage: it compresses full-dimensional input features into a compact latent space for efficient computation, then expands to generate high-dimensional QKV matrices instead of returning to a low-dimensional feature map. Unlike inverted bottlenecks that act as general convolutional feature extractors in backbone stages, ACCAP is purpose-built for linear attention’s QKV generation, with the core objective of mitigating linear attention’s inherent representational degradation rather than solely reducing computational overhead.
blocks.zh: 为了明确澄清ACCAP与上述信道压缩范式的新型界限,我们在设计动机、结构地形和功能目标方面与两个最相关的结构——倒置的残余瓶颈和低排名的QKV指数化——进行比较。 与 " 窄宽窄窄 " 维度轨迹的逆向残余瓶颈形成对照,后者在投射回低维特性输出之前暂时扩大空间演化的通道,ACAP采用了专门为QKV投射阶段设计的“宽窄宽宽宽宽”通道转换:它将全维输入特性压缩成一个紧凑的潜在空间,以便高效计算,然后扩展生成高维QKV矩阵而不是返回低维特性图. 与在骨干阶段充当一般演化特征提取器的倒置瓶颈不同,ACCAP是为线性关注的QKV生成而专门设计的,其核心目标是减轻线性关注的内在代表降解,而不仅仅是减少计算间接费用。

blocks.en: Furthermore, standard low-rank QKV factorization approximates the full projection matrix via two successive linear mappings purely for parameter and computation reduction, with no non-linear feature refinement between layers. ACCAP, by contrast, inserts a ReLU6-based activation purification step between the compression and expansion projections, which filters invalid activations and refines feature semantics in the compressed latent space. Most importantly, ACCAP is not merely a low-rank approximation of the original QKV projection; it is a feature enhancement pipeline that preserves high-dimensional input semantics, reduces channels for efficiency, purifies critical feature information, and ultimately produces more expressive QKV matrices. This design directly targets the low-rank representational limitation of linear attention, rather than functioning simply as a parameter compression technique, which is also validated by the nearly unchanged feature rank across the pipeline in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 此外,标准的低阶QKV因子化通过两次连续的线性映射来接近完整的投影矩阵,纯粹是为了参数和计算还原,各层之间没有非线性特征的完善. 相比之下,ACCAP在压缩和膨胀预测之间插入一个基于ReLU6的激活净化步骤,该步骤在压缩潜伏空间中过滤无效激活并精炼特征语义. 最重要的是,ACCAP不仅仅是原QKV投影的低级近似;它是一个功能增强管道,保存高维输入语义,减少效率的渠道,净化关键特征信息,最终产生更多的表达式QKV矩阵. 这种设计直接针对线性关注的低级代表限制,而不是仅仅作为参数压缩技术发挥作用,图2中整个管道的几乎不变特征排名也验证了这一点.

blocks.zh: 3.4 网络结构

blocks.en: We propose the ACCAP-ViT model family (M0 to M3) to validate the effectiveness of our ACCAP-LA module. All models share a unified backbone (Figure 4 ), comprising an input stem, four hierarchical stages, and a task-adaptive head. Following the progressive feature learning paradigm, the backbone downsamples feature maps and expands channel dimensions as the network depth increases.

blocks.en:
Stage 1 and Stage 2 are composed of MBConv blocks, which extract low-level visual features (e.g., edges, textures and basic shapes) and perform initial spatial downsampling with progressive channel expansion. This lays the necessary foundation for subsequent high-level semantic feature learning.
Stage 3 and Stage 4 take our proposed ACCAP-LA module as the core component, with each module equipped with a residual connection. The ACCAP-LA module is designed to model complex long-range spatial dependencies and realize adaptive multi-scale semantic feature fusion, which is critical for high-level visual understanding.

第3阶段和第4阶段将我们提议的ACCAP-LA模块作为核心组成部分,每个模块都配备了剩余连接。 ACCAP-LA模块旨在模拟复杂的长程空间依赖性,实现适应性的多尺度语义特征聚变,这对高层视觉理解至关重要.

blocks.en: In this section, we conduct a comprehensive suite of experiments to systematically validate the effectiveness, transfer learning capability, and cross-architecture compatibility of the proposed ACCAP-LA module. All implementations are built on PyTorch 2.0.1 with CUDA 12.2, and all training, validation, and testing procedures are executed on a server equipped with an Intel Xeon Platinum 8280 CPU and 8 NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPUs. Parameter counts and FLOPs are computed under a unified 224×224 input resolution following standard conventions in lightweight vision models. Core implementation configurations and training hyperparameters are summarized in Table 2 for complete reproducibility.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们进行了一套全面的实验,系统地验证拟议的ACCAP-LA单元的有效性、转让学习能力和跨结构兼容性。 所有实施都以PyTorch 2.0.1为基础,配有CUDA 12.2,所有培训,验证和测试程序均在安装有Intel Xeon Platinum 8280 CPU和8 NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU的服务器上执行. 参数计数和FLOP按照轻量级视觉模型的标准常规,按照224x224的统一输入分辨率计算。 表2汇总了核心执行配置和培训超参数,以便完全可复制。

blocks.en: We first instantiate the ACCAP-ViT model family and perform pre-training on the ImageNet-1K dataset to verify its performance on the fundamental image classification task. We then transfer the ImageNet-1K pre-trained ACCAP-ViT backbones to the object detection task for comparative experiments with existing efficient models, evaluating the module’s utility on downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们首先对ACCAP-ViT模型家族进行即时测试,并对ImageNet-1K数据集进行预训,以验证其在基本图像分类任务上的性能. 然后,我们将ImageNet-1K预先训练的ACCAP-ViT主干线转移到对象检测任务上,以便与现有的高效模型进行比较实验,评价该模块对下游任务的效用.

blocks.en: Furthermore, we carry out extensive ablation studies to dissect the key design choices and component contributions of ACCAP-LA. Specifically, we first ablate individual modules of ACCAP-LA, to quantify the performance gain brought by each component. On this basis, we further investigate the impact of critical hyperparameter configurations (e.g., different compression and Expansion ratios) on performance and integrate the ACCAP-LA module into classic lightweight vision transformers (PVT [ 6 ] , EfficientViT [ 10 ] , Swin [ 5 ] ) to validate its plug-and-play generalizability. The detailed experimental settings, results, and in-depth analysis for each of the above experiments are presented in the following subsections.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们进行了广泛的消化研究,以解析ACCAP-LA的主要设计选择和组成部分贡献。 具体地说,我们首先放弃ACCAP-LA的各个单元,以量化每个组成部分带来的业绩收益。 在此基础上,我们进一步调查了临界超参数配置(如不同的压缩和扩展比率)对性能的影响,并将ACCAP-LA模块整合到经典轻量级视变器(PVT [6],高效ViT [10],Swin [5])中,以验证其插值和游戏通用性. 以下各小节介绍上述每项实验的详细实验设置,结果和深入分析.

blocks.en: 4.1 ImageNet-1K Classification
blocks.zh: 4.1 图像网-1K分类

blocks.en: We conduct the image classification experiment on the ImageNet-1K dataset, which consists of 1.2 million training images and 50K validation images across 1000 object categories. To fully evaluate the performance of our ACCAP-ViT, we compare it with existing efficient models based on CNNs, ViT, Mamba, and their hybrid architectures under the same experimental setup. Specifically, we adopt the AdamW optimizer for training; the training process running for 300 epochs, with a batch size of 128 and the input image resolution uniformly resized to 224×224. The comprehensive comparison results in terms of Top-1/Top-5 accuracy, Floating-point Operations (FLOPs, M), and number of parameters (Params, M) are presented in Table 3 .
blocks.zh: 我们在ImageNet-1K数据集上进行图像分类实验,由120万个训练图像和5万个验证图像组成,跨越1000个对象类别. 为了充分评价我们的ACCAP-ViT的性能,我们将它与基于CNN,VIT,Mamba的现有高效模型及其在同一实验设置下的混合结构进行比较. 具体来说,我们采用AdamW优化器进行培训;培训流程为300个世纪,批量大小为128个,输入图像分辨率统一调整为224×224。 表3按Top-1/Top-5精度、浮点操作(FLOPs,M)和参数数(Params,M)作了综合比较。

blocks.en: Table 4 : Comparison of ACCAP-ViT Object Detection Performance on COCO 2017 with Existing Efficient Models.
blocks.zh: 表4:2017年COCO的ACCAP-ViT对象检测性能与现有高效模型的比较.

blocks.en: Across all model scales (M0 to M3), our ACCAP-ViT consistently achieves the best Top-1 and Top-5 accuracy among counterparts with comparable parameter counts or FLOPs, demonstrating a superior performance-efficiency trade-off on ImageNet-1K. For lightweight models, ACCAP-ViT-M0 outperforms EfficientViT-M0 [ 20 ] and S3ML-ViT-M0 [ 9 ] by 9.1% and 5.2% in Top-1 accuracy respectively. For medium and large scales (M1-M3), our models maintain this leading trend: ACCAP-ViT-M1 (4.3M params) achieves a 77.5% Top-1 accuracy, outperforming InceptionNeXt-A [ 27 ] by 2.2%; ACCAP-ViT-M3 even hits an 81.4% Top-1 and 95.7% Top-5 accuracy with only 9.0M params, outperforming large models like VRWKV-S (23.8M params, 80.1% Top-1) [ 33 ] and Vim-S (26.0M params, 80.3% Top-1) [ 39 ] with much fewer parameters and lower FLOPs.
blocks.zh: 在所有模型尺度(M0至M3)中,我们的ACCAP-ViT在具有可比参数计数或FLOP的对应方中始终达到最佳的Top-1和Top-5精度,显示出在ImageNet-1K上优异的性能效率权衡. 对于轻量级模型,ACCAP-ViT-M0在效率ViT-M0[20]和S3ML-ViT-M0[9]上分别以9.1%和5.2%的Top-1精度超标. 对于中尺度和大尺度(M1-M3),我们的模型保持了这一主要趋势:ACCAP-ViT-M1(4.3M参数)达到77.5%的Top-1精度,优于受体NEXt-A[27]的2.2%;ACCAP-ViT-M3甚至击中81.4%的Top-1和95.7%的Top-5精度,只有9.0M参数,优于VRWKV-S(23.8M参数,80.1%Top-1)[33]和Vim-S(26.0M参数,80.3%Top-1)[39],参数少得多,FLOP更低。

blocks.en: Notably, our ACCAP-ViT outperforms not only vanilla ViT and CNN-based models but also recent Mamba [ 32 ] and hybrid architectures [ 9 ] , which validates the effectiveness of the proposed ACCAP-LA mechanism. Unlike existing models that often sacrifice accuracy for efficiency, ACCAP-ViT realizes a simultaneous improvement in both metrics, making it more suitable for resource-constrained visual classification tasks.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,我们的ACCAP-ViT的绩效不仅优于香草ViT和基于CNN的模型,而且最近曼巴[32]和混合结构[9],这验证了拟议的ACCAP-LA机制的有效性。 与通常为了效率而牺牲准确性的现有模型不同,ACCAP-ViT实现两个度量衡同时改进,使其更适合资源约束的视觉分类任务.

blocks.en: 4.2 COCO 2017 Object Detection
blocks.zh: 4.2 COCO 2017 物体探测

blocks.en: We perform object detection experiments using the RetinaNet framework, with our ACCAP-ViT adopted as the backbone network. The experiments are conducted on the COCO 2017 dataset, which comprises 118K training images and 5K validation images. To facilitate effective training and transfer learning, our ACCAP-ViT-M1 backbone is initialized with pre-trained weights on ImageNet-1K. Following previous work [ 40 ] , we employ the AdamW optimizer with an initial learning rate of 0.0002, and the model is trained for 12 epochs. We compare ACCAP-ViT-M1 with representative efficient CNN and ViT-based backbones under the same RetinaNet (1× schedule) setup. Detailed results are summarized in Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 我们利用RetinaNet框架进行物体探测实验,我们采用ACCAP-ViT作为骨干网络。 实验是在COCO 2017数据集上进行的,数据集包括118K训练图像和5K验证图像. 为了促进有效的培训和转移学习,我们的ACCAP-ViT-M1主干线在ImageNet-1K上以预先训练过的权重初始化. 在之前的作品[40]之后,我们采用了亚当W优化器,初始学习率为0.0002,模型为12个纪元训练. 我们把ACCAP-ViT-M1与具有代表性的高效的CNN和基于ViT的骨干网在同一个RetinaNet(1×时刻表)设置下进行比较. 详细结果见表4。

blocks.en: With a slightly lower parameter count (4.3 M) compared to S3ML-ViT-M1 (4.4 M) [ 9 ] , our ACCAP-ViT-M1 achieves comprehensively superior detection performance. It attains an overall AP of 36.0%, which outperforms all compared models regardless of architecture type. All associated detection metrics of ACCAP-ViT-M1 also rank first, confirming its excellent capability in feature representation for object detection tasks.
blocks.zh: 与S3ML-ViT-M1(4.4 M)[9]相比,我们的ACCAP-ViT-M1的参数计数略低(4.3 M),实现了全面优异的检测性能. 它实现了36.0%的总的AP,无论建筑类型如何,都比所有模型都好。 ACCAP-ViT-M1的所有相关检测度量表也排在首位,证实了其在用于物体检测任务的特征表现方面的出色能力.

blocks.en: ACCAP-ViT-M1 does not perform well in terms of FLOPs (432M), and this is attributed to the number of stacked blocks designed for each stage during the backbone development. In lightweight efficient network design, parameter count is often a more critical consideration. This is because parameters directly correlate with model memory footprint, deployment difficulty and inference latency, which are core constraints in real-world applications. We thus specifically select models with similar parameter counts for fair comparison. Its strong performance on object detection tasks further proves that it possesses great potential for migration to downstream visual tasks.
blocks.zh: ACCAP-ViT-M1在FLOP(432M)方面表现不佳,这归功于主干开发期间为每个阶段设计的堆积块的数量. 在轻量级高效的网络设计中,参数计数常常是一个更为关键的考虑因素. 这是因为参数与模型内存足迹,部署难度和推论延迟直接相关,是现实世界应用的核心制约因素. 因此,我们专门选择具有类似参数的模型进行公平比较。 它在物体探测任务的强效表现进一步证明它具有向下游视觉任务迁移的巨大潜力.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.3 发育研究

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Ablation Study on Core Modules
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 关于核心单元的研究

blocks.en: To quantify the contribution of each core component in ACCAP-ViT and clarify their individual effects on model performance, we conduct ablation experiments on the ImageNet-1K dataset based on ACCAP-ViT-M1. Specifically, we perform single-module removal experiments: each time only one key module is removed while all other components remain intact. The ablated modules include ACCAP module, the Focused Kernel Function, Multi-Scale Feature module, and Self-Gating module. We also ablate the activation function of the Self-Gating module and replace the original ReLU6() (used in ACCAP) with tan() to explore the impact of activation function selection within ACCAP. The results, presented as Top-1 accuracy degradation relative to the baseline, are summarized in Table 5 .
blocks.zh: 为了量化ACCAP-ViT中每个核心部分的贡献,并澄清它们对模型性能的个别影响,我们在基于ACCAP-ViT-M1的ImageNet-1K数据集上进行了消融实验. 具体来说,我们进行单单元清除实验:每次只移除一个关键模块,而所有其他组件都完好无损. 已取消的模块包括ACCAP模块、聚焦核心功能模块、多尺度特性模块和自定模块。 我们还降低自转模块的激活功能,并将原始的ReLU6()(在ACCAP中使用)替换为tan(),以探索ACCAP内激活功能选择的影响. 表5汇总了作为与基准相对的Top-1精确度降解的结果。

blocks.en: Table 5 : Ablation Study on ImageNet-1K: Top-1 Accuracy Comparison for Each Module Removal.
blocks.zh: 表5:ImageNet-1K的读取研究:每个模块删除的Top-1精确度比较.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 5 , removing different modules causes varying performance degradation, and the ACCAP exerts the most prominent influence (-3.838%). The Multi-Scale Feature module contributes notably (0.692% reduction), validating the value of multi-scale input features. Removing the Self-Gating module results in a 0.562% drop, highlighting its role in adaptive feature adjustment. The Focused Kernel Function, the Self-Gating activation function and the replacement of ReLU6() to tan() have minor impacts, serving as auxiliary fine-tuning components. These results confirm the rationality of each module design, with ACCAP being the pivotal driver of the model’s performance advantage.
blocks.zh: 如表5所示,删除不同的模块会造成不同业绩退化,而ACCAP发挥最显著的影响(3.838%)。 多尺度特性模块显著(减少0.692%),验证了多尺度输入特性的价值。 移除自定模块导致0.562%的下降,突出其在适应特征调整中的作用. Focused Kernel函数,自Gating激活函数和ReLU6()到tan()的替换具有轻微的影响,作为辅助微调组件. 这些结果证实了每个模块设计的合理性,而ACCAP是模型性能优势的关键驱动力.

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Generalization Verification of ACCAP-LA
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 核查ACCAP-LA

blocks.en: To validate the plug-and-play capability and generalizability of the proposed ACCAP-LA mechanism, we replace the original attention modules of three classic lightweight vision transformers—EfficientViT-b1 [ 10 ] , PVT-T [ 41 ] , and Swin-T [ 5 ] —with ACCAP-LA, and evaluate their performance on ImageNet-1K (the models with “*” denote the variants after replacement).
blocks.zh: 为了验证拟议的ACCAP-LA机制的插座和播放能力和通用性,我们用ACCAP-LA替换了三个经典轻量级视觉变压器的原始注意模块——EfficicientViT-b1 [10],PVT-T [41],和Swin-T [5],并在ImageNet-1K上评价它们的性能(使用“*”的模型表示更换后的变体).

blocks.en: Table 6 : Generalization Verification of ACCAP-LA by Replacing Attention Mechanisms of classic methods.
blocks.zh: 表6:通过取代传统方法的注意机制对ACCAP-LA进行普遍核查。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 6 , ACCAP-LA brings consistent performance improvements across all tested models, demonstrating its effectiveness and compatibility with different transformer architectures. Specifically, the performance gains are more significant in models with smaller parameter counts: EfficientViT-b1* achieves a Top-1 accuracy of 81.4% (+3.3%) with slightly reduced parameters (9.0M vs. 9.1M), and PVT-T* obtains an accuracy of 78.5% (+3.4%) while maintaining the same parameter count. In contrast, Swin-T* only gains 0.8% accuracy, indicating that ACCAP-LA is currently more suitable for small-scale models. How to further extend the effectiveness of ACCAP-LA to large-scale models with more complex structures remains a valuable direction for future research.
blocks.zh: 如表6所示,ACCAP-LA对所有测试过的模型都带来一致的性能改进,显示出其有效性和与不同变压器架构的兼容性. 具体来说,在参数计数较小的模型中,性能增益更为显著: 高效ViT-b1* 实现81.4%的Top-1精度(+3.3%),参数略有降低(9.0M对9.1M),PVT-T*在保持参数计数的同时获得78.5%的精度(+3.4%). 相比之下,Swin-T*只获得0.8%的准确度,表明ACCAP-LA目前更适合小规模模型. 如何将ACCAP-LA的有效性进一步扩大到结构更复杂的大型模型,仍然是未来研究的宝贵方向.

blocks.en: 4.3.3 Computational Efficiency Comparison
blocks.zh: 4.3.3 计算效率比较

blocks.en: To quantify the computational efficiency of ACCAP-LA, we compare its inference speed against six mainstream attention mechanisms [ 20 , 16 , 9 , 6 , 31 , 5 ] under a unified setting. For fairness, we test only the attention module with identical input (batch size 32, 128 channels, 56×56 feature map) on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU, reporting per-sample latency and throughput.
blocks.zh: 为了量化ACCAP-LA的计算效率,我们将其推论速度与六个主流关注机制[20,16,9,6,31,5]在一个统一的设定下进行比较. 为了公平起见,我们只在单 NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU 上测试具有相同输入(批量大小32,128频道,56×56特征图)的注意力模块,报告每个样本的耐用性和吞吐量.

blocks.en: Table 7 : Computational Efficiency Comparison of Different Attention Modules.
blocks.zh: 表7:不同关注单元的计算效率比较。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 7 , ACCAP-LA achieves the lowest latency (0.0788 ms/sample) and highest throughput (12683.38 samples/s), outperforming all baselines by a clear margin and validating its superior computational efficiency.
blocks.zh: 如表7所示,ACCAP-LA实现了最低延迟(0.0788 ms/sample)和最高吞吐量(12683.38个样本/s),以明确的比值超过所有基线,并验证其优越的计算效率。

blocks.en: 4.3.4 Ablation Study on Compression and Expansion Ratios
blocks.zh: 4.3.4 关于压缩和扩大比率的研究

blocks.en: To optimize the hyperparameter configuration of ACCAP and clarify the impact of channel compression and expansion ratios on model performance, we conduct ablation experiments on these two key ratios. We set multiple ratio combinations for compression and expansion respectively, with ACCAP-ViT-M1 as the baseline. Table 8 presents the variation of Top-1 accuracy relative to the baseline (77.488%), where negative values indicate performance degradation.
blocks.zh: 为了优化ACCAP的超参数配置,并澄清信道压缩和扩展比率对模型性能的影响,我们对这两个关键比率进行了减速实验. 我们分别为压缩和扩展设定了多比例组合,以ACCAP-ViT-M1为基准. 表8列出了Top-1精确度相对于基线(77.488 %)的变化,负值表明性能退化。

blocks.en: Table 8 : Ablation Study on Compression and Expansion Ratios in ACCAP.
blocks.zh: 表8:关于ACCAP压缩和扩展比率的研究。

blocks.en: As indicated in Table 8 , the compression and expansion ratios significantly affect the performance of the model, and overall performance tends to degrade as both ratios decrease. The combination of 1/4 compression ratio and 1/2 expansion ratio achieves the best performance (consistent with the baseline), confirming it as the optimal configuration for ACCAP. In particular, the 1/2 compression + 1/2 expansion combination suffers a substantial accuracy drop of 1.664%, which is attributed to the cancellation of the subsequent expansion process in this group. All other combinations retain the complete ACCAP pipeline with only ratio adjustments. This result demonstrates that mere channel compression cannot ensure good performance and that the activation purification component in ACCAP plays a critical role in improving the quality of the features.
blocks.zh: 如表8所示,压缩和扩展比率严重影响模型的性能,总体性能往往随着这两个比率的降低而下降。 1/4压缩比和1/2扩展比的组合实现了最佳性能(与基线一致),证实了这是ACCAP的最佳配置. 特别是1/2压缩+1/2扩展组合的精度大幅下降1.664 %,这归因于该组后来的扩展过程被取消. 所有其他组合都保留了完整的ACCAP管道,仅对比例进行调整. 这一结果表明,光是信道压缩不能确保良好的性能,而ACCAP的激活净化部分在提高特性质量方面起着关键作用。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Visualization comparison of attention feature maps. Columns from left to right: (a) original image, (b) vanilla linear attention, (c) our proposed ACCAP-LA.
blocks.zh: 图5:关注特征图的可视化比较. 从左到右各栏:(a) 原始图像;(b) 香草线性注意;(c) 我们提议的ACCAP-LA。

blocks.en: 4.4 Attention Visualization
blocks.zh: 4.4 注意可视化

blocks.en: To provide supplementary qualitative verification beyond our quantitative ablation study, we conduct visualization analysis of attention feature maps using samples from the ImageNet-1K validation set, comparing vanilla linear attention and our proposed ACCAP-LA. As shown in Figure 5 , our ACCAP-LA empowered by the focused kernel function achieves significantly enhanced focusing capability, which can accurately focus on key target regions in images. Meanwhile, the ACCAP mechanism effectively filters redundant feature information and suppresses the model’s attention to non-target background areas. These qualitative observations are consistent with our quantitative experimental results, further validating the effectiveness of our method.
blocks.zh: 为了在我们量化研究之外提供补充质量核查,我们利用ImageNet-1K验证集的样本,对注意力特征图进行可视化分析,比较香草线性注意力和我们提议的ACCAP-LA。 如图5所示,通过重点内核功能赋予我们的ACCAP-LA,大大提高了重点能力,在图像中可以准确地聚焦于关键目标区域. 同时,ACCAP机制有效地过滤了多余的特征信息,压制了模型对非目标背景领域的关注. 这些定性观测结果与我们的定量实验结果一致,进一步验证了我们的方法的有效性.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: To address the efficiency-capability dilemma of attention mechanism in Vision Transformers, this paper proposes ACCAP-LA, a novel lightweight linear attention mechanism that for the first time embeds the Adaptive Channel Compression and Activation Purification (ACCAP) mechanism into the QKV projection process. This design fundamentally mitigates the representational degradation of vanilla linear attention while achieving substantial reductions in computational overhead and parameter count. Extensive experiments across image classification and object detection tasks validate that the proposed ACCAP-ViT series delivers superior efficiency-capability trade-offs compared to state-of-the-art CNNs, ViT, and Mamba-based efficient models. Comprehensive ablation studies confirm the rationality of each component’s design and the crucial role of ACCAP in driving performance gains, while cross-architecture generalization experiments demonstrate ACCAP-LA’s plug-and-play compatibility with classic lightweight transformers. Future work will delve deeper into the underlying mechanisms of adaptive channel compression and activation purification, and extend the proposed framework to large-scale models, aiming to further advance the development and practical application of efficient Vision Transformers.
blocks.zh: 为了解决Vision Transformers中关注机制的效率-能力难题,本文提出了ACCAP-LA,这是一种新的轻量级线性关注机制,首次将适应性通道压缩和激活净化(ACCAP)机制嵌入QKV投影过程. 这一设计从根本上缓解了香草线性关注的表示退化,同时实现了计算间接费用和参数计数的大幅降低. 跨图像分类和物体探测任务的广泛实验证实,与最先进的有线电视新闻网、虚拟电视网和基于曼巴的高效模型相比,拟议的ACCAP-ViT系列提供了更高的效率能力权衡。 综合的促销研究证实了每个组件的设计的合理性以及ACCAP在驱动性能增益方面的关键作用,而跨结构的泛化实验则证明了ACCAP-LA的插座和游戏兼容性与经典轻量级变压器. 今后的工作将更深入地探索适应性信道压缩和激活净化的基本机制,并将拟议框架扩大到大规模模型,目的是进一步推动高效的愿景变换器的开发和实际应用。
